text: Could not establish that an author will classify direction correctly. AC5 asks for stricter, more-permissive or no, and nothing in the tree can check the answer — a wrong 'no' on a loosening change is indistinguishable from a right one. The spec says recorded and attributable rather than verified, and scopes a replay harness out; proceeding on a disclosure this product cannot itself verify is the weakest point in it
